title: Hyaluronic acid-loaded drug-eluting nanofibrous pad for the treatment of degenerative arthritis

This study developed a degradable, hyaluronic acid-loaded, drug-eluting nanofibrous pad designed to provide extended pain relief and prevent infection at the knee joint.
